Keep the same two fictional cartoon characters, full-body framing, square composition, thick black outlines, colors, and chibi proportions. Keep the man on the left and the woman on the right, preserving their existing clothing, hairstyles, accessories, and the man's straw hat and woven backpack basket. Turn the man's head and gaze toward the woman on his right, and turn the woman's head and gaze toward the man on her left, creating clear mutual eye contact. Neither character should look at the viewer. The man is about to leave to gather bamboo shoots, looking back toward his wife with one hand raised in a small casual farewell and his mouth slightly open as if saying 'いってくるよ'. The woman looks directly at him with a gentle everyday smile, holding the dishcloth in both hands. Adjust their upper bodies slightly toward one another so the exchange feels natural. Keep both figures fully visible and separate. Preserve a fully transparent background, including the space between the figures. No scenery, additional people, text, captions, lettering, or speech bubbles; the man's Japanese dialogue will be added during editing. Do not attempt to reconstruct the real victims' appearances.
